title: Regulatory Rating Selection Rule
user_story: As a regulatory capital analyst, I want a single regulatory rating derived from the ratings of multiple agencies so that capital charges are calculated consistently.

acceptance_criteria.text: Ratings from MOODYS, FITCH and NORTHBRIDGE (uses Fitch-style symbols) are compared on the common rank from the cross-agency mapping (1 = highest).
If exactly one eligible rating exists, it is the regulatory rating (rule_applied=SINGLE).
If two eligible ratings exist, the lower (worse) of the two is the regulatory rating (rule_applied=LOWER_OF_TWO).
If three eligible ratings exist, take the two best ratings and use the lower of those two (rule_applied=SECOND_BEST).
Withdrawn (WR, WD) and not-rated (NR) entries are not eligible. If no eligible rating exists, the result is UNRATED.
The result includes regulatory_rank, regulatory_rating (Fitch-style symbol), source_agency and rule_applied.
